name: What is the typical lifespan of different metal roofing materials?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of different metal roofing materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of metal roofing varies by material, but most types significantly outlast traditional asphalt shingles. Steel and aluminum roofs can last 40-70 years, while copper and zinc roofs can exceed 100 years with proper maintenance. This extended durability is a key advantage of metal roofing. To maximize your roof's lifespan, ensure professional installation and adhere to recommended maintenance schedules, which our team can provide guidance on.
acceptedAnswer.description: Metal roofs like steel and aluminum can last 40-70 years, while copper and zinc can exceed 100 years, far surpassing asphalt shingles.
